# GP JSON fixtures

25544.json contains the mean elements from examples/tui-demo/iss.tle, a saved ISS snapshot dated 2026-10-24. The epoch is the exact equivalent of its eight-decimal TLE day field.

100001.json and 799500001.json reuse those elements with synthetic catalog IDs. They test six- and nine-digit handling without provider access; they are not observations of those catalog objects.
